purpose: A static site of small, self-contained tools. Each one is files in a browser: no account, no server, and nothing collected.

pages.name: Flows
pages.description: Twenty single-purpose tools, one self-contained HTML file each. Every one works offline and keeps its data in the browser it is opened in.

pages.name: Lunar South Pole PSR Map
pages.description: Interactive map of permanently shadowed regions at the Moon's south pole, with habitat-feasibility distances to water ice.

pages.name: LTEC
pages.description: A first-order interactive model of Lunar Thermal Energy Conversion between a 28 K crater floor and a 118 K sunlit rim.

pages.name: ACSA Archive
pages.description: Public archive of research papers and technical notes from the Australian Crewed Spaceflight Agency, published as citable pages.

pages.name: Science
pages.description: Interactive lessons on space and flight.
